create.name: Flora Bowley
create.bio:
Flora Bowley is a painter, author and creative guide from Portland, Oregon, whose teaching treats intuitive painting as a way into presence, self-trust and a fuller sense of being alive. Raised in Green Bay, Wisconsin, she took a degree in painting and drawing and spent around a decade living and making work along the West Coast, while also studying yoga and massage, sitting long meditation retreats and travelling widely. She changed her first name from Shannon to Flora as she neared thirty, and in 2010 she led her first painting workshop, which set the direction of her later work.

Her approach mixes layered, process-led painting with movement, breathwork, free writing and group sharing, and asks students to let go of perfectionism and follow curiosity rather than a fixed plan. She has written Brave Intuitive Painting, Creative Revolution, Fresh Paint (with Lynzee Lynx) and the memoir-style The Art of Aliveness. Today she teaches through self-paced online courses, a monthly online community called FREE FLO with live sessions and guest teachers, and small week-long residential retreats in places such as Bali, Morocco and Thailand.

books.title: Brave Intuitive Painting
books.author: Flora Bowley
books.description: Her first book, a hands-on guide to painting in layers without planning the outcome, with exercises for loosening up, working with colour and building a personal style.

books.title: Creative Revolution
books.author: Flora Bowley
books.description: A follow-up that carries her painting approach into daily life, pairing studio exercises with reflections on curiosity, change and living more creatively.

books.title: Fresh Paint
books.author: Flora Bowley, Lynzee Lynx
books.description: Written with fellow painter Lynzee Lynx, it guides readers through making a long series of small mixed-media pieces as a way to find a style of their own.

books.title: The Art of Aliveness
books.author: Flora Bowley
books.description: A personal book in which she tells formative stories from her own life and draws out what years of painting and teaching have shown her about living fully.

courses.title: Reunite
courses.description: A self-paced online course that walks through her whole intuitive painting process as taught on her in-person retreats, with around thirty hours of recorded teaching and lifetime access.

courses.title: Creative Revolution e-course
courses.description: Recorded online programme of guided art, movement and mindful exercises meant to bring creativity into everyday life, with a printable workbook of prompts.

courses.title: Fresh Paint
courses.description: An in-depth recorded course, co-created with Lynzee Lynx, in which students make a hundred small mixed-media paintings to discover their own visual voice.

courses.title: The Painting Sessions
courses.description: Twelve themed videos following paintings from blank canvas to finish with her commentary, for people who learn best by watching. Sessions can also be bought singly.

courses.title: FREE FLO Community
courses.description: Her online membership with monthly themes, live creative gatherings, guest teachers and a library of more than a hundred recorded sessions. The first week is free.

courses.title: The Art of Aliveness Retreat: Ubud, Bali
courses.description: An eight-day residential retreat at an eco-cottage venue in Ubud combining intuitive painting, writing, breathwork, movement and time to explore local culture.

courses.title: The Art of Aliveness Retreat: Agadir, Morocco
courses.description: Eight days and seven nights near the Atlas foothills for a small group of up to seventeen, mixing painting, movement, writing and creative play.

courses.title: The Art of Aliveness Retreat: Thailand
courses.description: A week by the sea on Thailand's central coast with daily expressive painting, community time and space to rest.
